svg.title: Shoot4Fun monogram
svg.desc: Crosshair mark with the digit 4 at the center, in brand primary coral-red (#F94B1F, the HSL→hex of `--primary: 12 95% 55%`). Favicon-friendly 64x64 viewBox; rasterises legibly at 32x32 (full lockup) and 16x16 (crosshair-only — the 4 is a single glyph and survives at 16x16 if the rasteriser can resolve the font). The build passes Russo One or Bungee in its font context (or converts the text to a path at scaffold time) so the 4 renders with the brand wordmark weight.

text.font-family: Russo One, Bungee, Impact, system-ui, sans-serif
